description: Election Commission - Declare that A. A. S Gunarathna as member of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
